title: Probability of a finite set of outputs
statement: Let $m$ be a nonnegative integer, let $g$ map Boolean strings to nonnegative integers, and let $T$ be a finite set of nonnegative integers. Under the uniform distribution on Boolean strings of length $m$, the probability that $g$ takes a value in $T$ is the sum, over $j\in T$, of the probabilities that $g$ equals $j$.
hypotheses_covered: $T$ is a finite set of nonnegative integers
